title: How To Setup Member Logo as Backup | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
content: How To Setup Member Logo as Backup Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000034924 If a member does not have a profile photo, with this setting enabled the system will use the member's logo as a profile photo - and vice versa. Navigate to Settings >> Advanced Settings and search for: Member Logo As Backup Database Variable: override_profile_photo For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard .
